name: Evade Asgore as Dess [BERGENTRUCK]
desc:
[BIG UPDATE!] Evade Asgore As Dess [Deltarune]

[THIS GAME IS STILL IN BETA, EXPECT BUGS AND GLITCHES]

A player at random is chosen to be either a Survivor or a Driver. The Drivers has to run over all the deer shaped speed bumps, while the Survivors have to use their different abilities to survive. Earn more Cash the longer you survive. You can use your cash to buy new drivers and survivors.

We reverted the brainrot update unfortunately.

Controls: Shift to Sprint | Q to use Ability
Mobile: On-Screen buttons
Console: Coming soon..
